title: Simulation clock heartbeat (topic: sim.clock, compacted, key='clock')
description: Published by the replayer once per REPLAY_CLOCK_INTERVAL_S. It is the single source of truth for 'now' in sim time. The API uses it to timestamp student rides, and the UI shows it on screen.

speed.description: Sim seconds per wall second, or the string 'max' in backfill mode.

row_idx.description: Index of the next row to be produced in the prepared replay file.
